He is best known for his Urdu and Persian poetry, and is considered one of the greatest poets of the Deccan. His works include the Diwan-i-Sajjad and the Masnavi-i-Sajjad.

Sajad is also mentioned in the history of the Mughal Empire, as a poet and scholar who served under the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in the mid-17th century. He is credited with writing the Persian text 'Adab-i-Muhammadi' which is a treatise on the etiquette and behavior of the Mughal court.
